# PDF.js browser assets

Official pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, from https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js. Apache-2.0 license retained in LICENSE.

Only the minified browser module and worker are included. Loaded on demand for local text extraction; no document is uploaded to a remote service. Rendering, OCR and encrypted-document entry are not implemented.
